prospero_win.note: Rebased onto upstream b510eb3 on 2026-10-08. Any-title shell on fixed kit B (25a967d). Firmware 13.60 uses the authorized no-drop fallback; games retain root recovery. Runtime remains bea2be5. Same tree as kit C's shell revision 850e62c (history squashed; the old commits are on backup/z3cloudplay-ps5-850e62c). 33130a9 adds publication metadata schema 3 (game_root.unowned) for game folders on exFAT drives. a9ce0d0 pins the packager to the kit D runtime built from 8ff88bf (rebased forks, direct-memory heap). Test branch feat/upstream-2026-10-10 (2026-10-10): rebased onto upstream ce890c0 (Mesa WGL/Zink OpenGL, PS5 OpenGL SDK path removed); patch 0663 dropped, ours renumbered 0950-0955; 3f8f559 pins the packager to the kit G runtime f29127a. Rebased again onto upstream 644e32e (kit H): our 0602 and the translator fallback 063f851 dropped for upstream #678/#677, patch 0956 keeps a window's pixel format with Mesa's WGL; 77231eb pins the packager to the kit H runtime bceed2d. 03b6495 (feat/z3cloudplay-ps5) adds only test, documentation and allowlist fixes on top of ab3b29e. 13fa077 adds Wine patch 0603 (upstream PR #688: Windows memory queries report the title's direct-memory budget) and ea6e6ee pins the packager to the kit H r8 runtime built from 13fa077.

prospero_kit.status: kit H r8: kit H r6 with ntdll.prx rebuilt from prospero-win 13fa077 with Wine patch 0603 (upstream PR #688): Windows memory queries report the title's direct-memory pool and largest free block, with an equal synthetic page file, instead of the sandbox's empty BSD readings (Fallout: New Vegas); r7 was a development kit; template, shell and Mono unchanged, so bottles need no Recreate. kit H r6: kit H r5 with the template bottle carrying what Wine Mono's support MSI (winemono-support.msi 11.3.0) writes when Wine installs it: HKLM\Software\Microsoft\.NETFramework InstallRoot (C:\windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\, and Framework\ in the Wow6432Node view), the policy, NET Framework Setup\NDP, Active Setup, Post Platform and XNA keys of its Registry table, the CorSymWriter class, and C:\windows\Microsoft.NET (mscorlib/machine.config stubs and Wine's fake DLLs, 60 files), taken from a real install with kit H's host Wine (tools/kit-h/update_r6.py), so mscoree's LoadLibraryShim finds the install root (Antichamber); Mono stays at the kit root; bottles made from an earlier template need Recreate bottle; runtime and shell unchanged. kit H r5: kit H r4 with the title shell rebuilt from prospero-win 4a1aa7a, which reads a profile's [environment] section (up to 8 DXVK_/MESA_/RADV_/SDL_ variables or WINE_CPU_TOPOLOGY, logged as PW_WINE64 environment NAME=value), and ntdll.prx rebuilt from 70bfc92 with Wine patch 0958 (WINE_CPU_TOPOLOGY lowers NumberOfProcessors to its count), so Game settings > Environment variables and CPU cores reach the game; capability settings-profile-environment; template unchanged. kit H r4: kit H r3 with Wine Mono 11.3.0 at the kit root (mono/wine-mono-11.3.0, uploaded once, not copied per title or bottle) and the template's user.reg pointing Wine's mscoree at it (HKCU\Software\Wine\Mono RuntimePath = Z:\data\z3cloudplay\kits\hl2-fw1360-dev1\mono\wine-mono-11.3.0), so .NET and mixed C++/CLI programs can start (ENSLAVED); capability wine-mono; bottles made from an earlier template need Recreate bottle; runtime unchanged. kit H r3: kit H r2 with Wine patch 0957 (prospero-win 2b91e15): kernelbase reads the stored computer name when wineboot's volatile ActiveComputerName key is missing, so dxdiagn initializes (GUN). kit H r2: kit H with Wine patch 0170 (prospero-win 2c4eaa6): ntdll records the path of a directory it receives from the in-process server, so names opened relative to a directory handle resolve (.NET recursive enumeration, Caves of Qud). kit H: everything rebuilt on prospero-win rebased onto upstream 644e32e (bceed2d), with GnuTLS schannel and patch 0956 for Godot's OpenGL window; as kit G: OpenGL games draw through Mesa WGL/Zink (PE32/PE64 in the any-title shell at win/mesa-zink), the PS5 OpenGL SDK path is gone, our Wine patches at 0950-0955; development kit (Mesa DLLs and libgnutls.prx carry build paths); console acceptance pending; authorized no-drop fallback
prospero_kit.runtime_inventory_source: Kit H r8: kit H r6 (r5's runtime) with ntdll.prx rebuilt from prospero-win 13fa077 (patch 0603) in the same work folder; every other file unchanged. Kit H r5: kit H r4 with ntdll.prx rebuilt from prospero-win 70bfc92 (patch 0958); every other file unchanged. Kit H r3: kit H r2 with kernelbase.dll (i386 and x86_64, runtime and template system32/syswow64 copies) rebuilt from prospero-win 2b91e15 (patch 0957); every other file unchanged. Kit H r2: kit H r1 with ntdll.prx rebuilt from prospero-win 2c4eaa6 (patch 0170); every other file unchanged. Kit H: as kit G r2, every file rebuilt from prospero-win bceed2d (upstream 644e32e; adds libgnutls.prx, secur32.prx and share/wine/ca-certificates.crt); kit G: kit F's runtime key set, every file rebuilt from prospero-win f29127a on ps5-amd64 under the path-neutral prefix map (host Wine, cross PRXs and patched PE modules, wowprospero, wow64native); template from kit A's with its 516 builtins plus every patched module re-sourced and the i386 HID drivers in syswow64/drivers; shell from f29127a with Mesa e4607ef WGL/Zink (build/kit-g). r2: libvulkan.prx relinked from PS5_Vulkan 8aee3af (PS5_Mesa 01d7057), whose VideoOut hands the display from a swapchain that never presented to the next, so SDL and wined3d GL probe windows no longer keep a Zink game black.
